درجة حرارة الفرن> 500 درجة. ج.

Voltmeter, mv

خطوات الاستعداد للاختبار
مراجعة المواد المرجعية الفنية ودليل التصنيع.
Obtain copy of the setting value of thermocouple.
Disconnect thermocouple wires and isolate the wires using tape.
يزيل thermocouple and take it to lab.

items: مراجعة المواد المرجعية الفنية ودليل التصنيع.
Obtain copy of the setting value of thermocouple.
Disconnect thermocouple wires and isolate the wires using tape.
يزيل thermocouple and take it to lab.

sections.text: Testing Procedure

Put the thermocouple into the oven and connect mv 
 meter to thermocouple 
 terminals.

Adjust oven temp. to the ref. value, wait 5 
 minutes, سجل قراءة الفولتميتر وقارنها 
 مع correct value.

Repeat step 2 but for the other
 degrees C.

sections.text:
Return thermocouple to 
Service

Return thermocouple to service by removing the 
 oven from the indicator vent.
Close indicator vent.
Open the manual isolating valve of indicator line.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.
